condition: all 19 source columns identical to an earlier row; first copy kept
reason: Same vendor, second-level timestamps, zones, distance and every fare component: a double submission, not two real trips

action: quarantine the negative reversal; keep the original
reason: TLC records a void/dispute as the original plus a negative reversal with identical timestamps: one pickup, two accounting rows. Counting both double-counts the pickup
